what: replay the exact begin -> STATUS -> pass1 -> real 536-word envelope through the real chain
chain: carrier_axi3_lite -> carrier_axil -> carrier_stream (+carrier_crc32); ICAPE2 omitted, pass 1 never asserts CSIB
dut_modified: no — the RTL is replayed exactly as published
master: written independently from the AXI3 spec; borrows no handshake assumption from the shim

envelope.source: envelope 0 of the sealed no-op payload

root_disagreement.host_source: manifest base_bitstream.idcode = 0x03722093, read from the carrier bitstream
root_disagreement.why_no_test_caught_it: tb_carrier_stream.v:112 hardcodes env_words[15] = 32h13722093, so the bench built its envelope to match the RTL rather than to match what the host emits; the host gate judges frame content, not the control skeleton

note_on_bursts: AXI3 returns ONE BRESP per burst, so scenario D attributes the response to the burst first beat and claims no per-beat resolution
not_done: no DUT change, no Vivado, no artifact re-publication, no board time
